policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: It is an expectation that all patients receive care/services from a licensed clinician. All appropriate supporting documentation, including recent pertinent office visit notes, laboratory data, and results of any special testing must be provided. If applicable: All prior relevant imaging results and the reason that alternative imaging cannot be performed must be included in the documentation submitted.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Advanced Diagnostic Imaging (CT, MRI, PET, Nuclear Medicine)

criteria.description: Care and services ordered or provided by a licensed clinician
Submission of recent pertinent office visit clinical notes
Submission of relevant laboratory data and special testing results

required_documentation: Recent pertinent office visit notes
Laboratory data
Prior relevant imaging reports
Clinical rationale why alternative imaging cannot be performed
review_notes: Universal baseline clinical intake requirement applying across all Evolent imaging guidelines.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: For suspected inflammatory bowel disease after complete work up including physical exam, labs, and recent colonoscopy
clinical_service_or_procedure: CT Abdomen and Pelvis (or CT Enterography)

criteria.description: Physical examination documented in medical records
Diagnostic laboratory workup completed
Recent colonoscopy completed prior to advanced imaging request

required_documentation: Physical examination notes
Laboratory results
Recent colonoscopy report
review_notes: Prerequisite workup rule for suspected new onset IBD.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: For evaluation of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) such as Crohn's or Ulcerative Colitis (includes CT enterography, however, MRI should be considered for age < 35 to reduce radiation exposure)
clinical_service_or_procedure: CT Abdomen and Pelvis / CT Enterography

criteria.description: Requested procedure is CT enterography or CT abdomen/pelvis for IBD
Patient age is strictly less than 35 years

required_documentation: Documentation of contraindication to MRI (if CT requested for age < 35)
review_notes: Advisory wording ('MRI should be considered'). Flagged for medical director determination regarding whether this constitutes a mandatory denial of CT or peer-to-peer advisory suggestion.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Suspected diverticulitis or acute appendicitis for initial imaging with at least ONE of the following (10): ○ WBC Elevated ○ Fever ○ Anorexia ○ Nausea and vomiting

criteria.description: Suspected acute diverticulitis or acute appendicitis for initial diagnostic evaluation
At least one objective inflammatory or systemic clinical sign present
Elevated white blood cell count (leukocytosis)
Documented fever
Documented anorexia
Documented nausea and vomiting

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing acute abdominal pain
Vital signs showing temperature/fever or CBC report showing elevated WBC
review_notes: Initial imaging indication with disjunctive clinical symptom checklist.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Suspected appendicitis in a child (< age 18) (12) when ultrasound is inconclusive or cannot be completed (due to body habitus or inability to cooperate) OR when peritoneal signs are present (guarding, rebound) or other red flags

criteria.description: Patient age is strictly less than 18 years
Provisional diagnosis is suspected acute appendicitis
Ultrasound inconclusive/incomplete OR peritoneal signs present
Prior ultrasound inconclusive or incomplete
Peritoneal signs documented (guarding, rebound) or other red flags

required_documentation: Ultrasound report demonstrating inconclusive results or documentation of inability to complete ultrasound
Physical examination notes documenting peritoneal signs (guarding, rebound) if ultrasound was bypassed
review_notes: Pediatric appendicitis radiation sparing protocol mandating ultrasound prior to CT unless peritoneal signs are present.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Initial imaging for suspected acute pancreatitis due to epigastric pain with elevated amylase and/or lipase: ○ Mild presentation when symptom improvement is not seen after 72 hours of treatment and either: ■ Ultrasound has been performed and did not show an abnormality such as gallstones, dilated bile duct ■ Ultrasound suggests complications (such as fluid collection)

criteria.description: Suspected acute pancreatitis with epigastric pain and elevated amylase and/or lipase
Mild presentation without symptom improvement after at least 72 hours of treatment
Prior ultrasound completed showing no gallstones/ductal dilation OR suggesting complications

required_documentation: Serum amylase and lipase laboratory reports
Clinical notes demonstrating persistent symptoms at or beyond 72 hours
Abdominal ultrasound report
review_notes: Temporal constraint requiring 72 hours of conservative care in mild pancreatitis before early CT is medically indicated.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Severe presentation (such as fever, elevated WBC) ○ Decline in clinical status and/or suspected complication

criteria.description: Severe presentation with fever and elevated WBC count
Decline in clinical status or suspected organ complication

required_documentation: Vital signs showing fever
CBC showing leukocytosis
Clinical notes documenting rapid clinical decline or suspected necrosis/phlegmon
review_notes: Severe acute pancreatitis indication bypassing the 72-hour observation window.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Kidney Stone is NOT suspected AND ● Urinalysis is negative for infection or hematuria persists on urine microscopy following treatment of urinary tract infection AND ● At least one of the following: ○ Gross hematuria ○ > 25 RBC/hpf on urine microscopy

criteria.description: Kidney stone is NOT suspected
Urinalysis negative for infection OR hematuria persists following UTI treatment
Gross hematuria OR > 25 RBC/hpf on urine microscopy
Documented gross hematuria
Greater than 25 RBC per high power field on urine microscopy

required_documentation: Urinalysis microscopy report showing RBC count or gross hematuria
Urine culture or documentation showing UTI ruled out or treated
review_notes: High-risk hematuria branch based on American Urological Association (AUA) guidelines.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: 3-25 RBC/hpf on urine microscopy AND ONE or more of the following: ■ >30 pack year smoking history ■ Male ≥ age 60 ■ Abnormal renal ultrasound ■ Negative renal ultrasound and repeat sample shows persistence of ≥ 3 RBC/hpf

criteria.description: 3 to 25 RBC/hpf documented on urine microscopy
At least one established urologic malignancy risk factor present
Greater than 30 pack-year smoking history
Male patient aged 60 or older
Abnormal renal ultrasound finding
Negative renal ultrasound with persistence of >= 3 RBC/hpf on repeat sample

required_documentation: Urine microscopy lab report showing 3-25 RBC/hpf
Clinical notes documenting smoking history, renal ultrasound report, or repeat UA
review_notes: Intermediate risk microscopic hematuria indication.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Aneurysm size 5.0-5.4 cm, every 6 months
clinical_service_or_procedure: CT Abdomen and Pelvis / CT Angiography Abdomen

criteria.description: Known abdominal aortic aneurysm with maximum diameter between 5.0 and 5.4 cm
At least 6 months elapsed since previous aortic imaging evaluation

required_documentation: Prior imaging report demonstrating AAA size 5.0 - 5.4 cm
Date of last prior aortic imaging study
review_notes: Surveillance frequency rule for pre-surgical threshold aneurysms.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Known or suspected symptomatic AAA (30,31) ○ Symptoms may include: ■ Abrupt onset of severe sharp or stabbing pain in the chest, back or abdomen (could indicate possible aneurysm rupture) ■ Acute abdominal or back pain with a pulsatile or epigastric mass ■ Acute abdominal or back pain and at high risk for aortic aneurysm and/or aortic syndrome (risk factors include hypertension, atherosclerosis, prior cardiac or aortic surgery, underlying aneurysm, connective tissue disorder (Such as Marfan syndrome, vascular form of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, Loeys-Dietz syndrome), and bicuspid aortic valve) (32)
clinical_service_or_procedure: CT Angiography / CT Abdomen and Pelvis

criteria.description: Known or clinically suspected symptomatic abdominal aortic aneurysm
Documentation of acute rupture symptoms, pulsatile mass, or high-risk features

required_documentation: Emergency department or urgent clinical evaluation note
Physical examination documenting pain characteristics, pulsatile mass, or hemodynamic instability
review_notes: Urgent indication for suspected rupture or acute expansion.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: When a cancer is not listed above, Abdomen and Pelvis CT is not routinely a part of surveillance for that cancer in an asymptomatic patient. There would need to be a sign or symptom of recurrence to consider Abdomen and Pelvis CT.

criteria.description: Primary cancer diagnosis is not specifically listed in guideline surveillance table
Patient is asymptomatic without signs or symptoms of recurrence

required_documentation: Oncology progress notes demonstrating active signs or symptoms of disease recurrence if CT is requested
exclusion_conditions: Routine routine surveillance CT in asymptomatic patients whose cancer type is not enumerated in guideline table
review_notes: Explicit policy exclusion barring routine unlisted cancer surveillance in asymptomatic individuals.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: PREOPERATIVE OR POSTOPERATIVE ASSESSMENT / Postoperative Evaluation
source_quote: Known or suspected complications ● A clinical reason is provided how imaging may change management NOTE: This section applies only within the first few months following surgery

criteria.description: Postoperative evaluation of known or suspected surgical complications
Surgery occurred within the first few months prior to imaging request
Clinical documentation demonstrates how imaging will alter management

required_documentation: Operative report and recent surgical follow-up notes documenting suspected complication
review_notes: Postoperative assessment window applying within first few months following abdominal/pelvic surgery.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: When separate requests for CT abdomen and CT Pelvis are encountered for processes involving both the abdomen and pelvis, they need to be resubmitted as Evolent Clinical Guideline 2000 for Abdomen and Pelvis CT (to avoid unbundling; CPT codes 74176, 74177, 74178).

criteria.description: Separate requests submitted for CT Abdomen and CT Pelvis
Clinical process or pathology involves both abdominal and pelvic anatomy

required_documentation: Clinical indication demonstrating pathology is strictly confined to upper abdomen if isolated CT Abdomen requested
review_notes: Anti-unbundling coding rule mandating combined CT Abdomen/Pelvis codes (74176-74178) when both regions are indicated.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: After confirmed diagnosis of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (EPI), one-time imaging to exclude a secondary cause for EPI. (Imaging is not indicated for workup of suspected pancreatic insufficiency; fecal elastase level < 100 µg/g is consistent with EPI)

criteria.description: Diagnosis of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency confirmed by fecal elastase
One-time imaging evaluation to exclude secondary structural etiology

required_documentation: Fecal elastase laboratory report demonstrating < 100 ug/g
exclusion_conditions: Imaging requested for initial workup of suspected pancreatic insufficiency prior to fecal elastase confirmation
review_notes: Diagnostic prerequisite mandating fecal elastase confirmation before one-time diagnostic CT.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Indeterminate renal mass on other imaging (13) ● Active surveillance for a solid renal mass(es) at 6 and 12 months, then annually

criteria.description: Known solid renal mass undergoing active surveillance
Surveillance interval matches protocol (6 mo, 12 mo, then annually)

required_documentation: Prior ultrasound, CT, or MRI report documenting solid renal mass and date of last scan
review_notes: Surveillance interval rule for solid renal mass active surveillance.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: Evaluation of Infection and Inflammation / Pancreatitis: Suspected and Known (27)
source_quote: In patients > 40 years of age who have pancreatitis with no identifiable cause (to exclude neoplasm)

criteria.description: Patient age strictly greater than 40 years
Documented acute or chronic pancreatitis
No identifiable cause established (idiopathic, no gallstones/alcohol etiology)

required_documentation: Clinical notes demonstrating idiopathic pancreatitis in patient over 40 and negative basic etiology workup
review_notes: Age-stratified oncology exclusion rule for idiopathic pancreatitis in patients over 40.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: Infection and Inflammation Limited to the Abdomen (27,29) / Hernia (30)
source_quote: Suspected hernia and one of the following: ○ Deep intraabdominal/pelvic hernia (post-Roux-en-Y) ○ Non-midline ventral hernia (including Spigelian hernia)

criteria.description: Clinically suspected abdominal wall hernia
Deep intraabdominal hernia post-gastric bypass OR non-midline ventral/Spigelian hernia
Post-Roux-en-Y gastric bypass with suspected internal hernia
Suspected non-midline ventral hernia or Spigelian hernia

required_documentation: Surgical or clinical notes detailing bariatric surgical history or physical examination of non-midline abdominal defect
review_notes: Complex abdominal wall and internal hernia indication.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN CTA / Renal Artery Stenosis
source_quote: In a patient with hypertension AND prior abnormal or inconclusive ultrasound with any ONE of the following (1,2): ● Onset of hypertension prior to the age of 30 without a family history of hypertension and when there is suspicion of fibromuscular dysplasia or a vasculitis ● Failure to obtain adequate blood pressure control on 3 antihypertensive medications, including one diuretic

criteria.description: Documented hypertension with prior abnormal or inconclusive renal artery duplex ultrasound
Early onset (<30 yr) without family history OR resistant hypertension on 3 medications including diuretic
Onset of hypertension prior to age 30 without family history
Refractory hypertension failing 3 concurrent antihypertensive drugs including a diuretic

required_documentation: Renal duplex ultrasound report demonstrating abnormal or inconclusive velocity measurements
Medication administration record detailing 3 concurrent antihypertensive agents with diuretic
review_notes: Secondary renovascular hypertension indication requiring prior ultrasound failure.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN CTA / Other Vascular Abnormalities of the Abdomen
source_quote: Initial evaluation of inconclusive vascular findings on prior imaging of the abdomen

criteria.description: Inconclusive or equivocal vascular finding on prior abdominal ultrasound or CT

required_documentation: Prior abdominal imaging report citing indeterminate vascular abnormality requiring definitive angiography
review_notes: Diagnostic clarification pathway for indeterminate vascular findings.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN MRA / Other Vascular Abnormalities / Takayasu's Arteritis (15)
source_quote: Takayasu's Arteritis (15): ○ At initial diagnosis ○ Every 6 months for the first 2 years while on therapy ○ Annually after the first 2 years

criteria.description: Confirmed diagnosis of Takayasu's arteritis
MRA requested at initial diagnosis, q6 months during first 2 years of active therapy, or annually thereafter

required_documentation: Rheumatology progress notes documenting Takayasu arteritis diagnosis, active immunosuppressive therapy, and prior imaging dates
review_notes: Radiation-free surveillance intervals for large-vessel vasculitis.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN MRA / Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm (AAA)
source_quote: Known or suspected symptomatic AAA when (1,2) ○ Symptoms may include: ■ Abrupt onset of severe sharp or stabbing pain in the chest, back or abdomen (could indicate possible aneurysm rupture) ■ Acute abdominal or back pain with a pulsatile or epigastric mass

criteria.description: Known or clinically suspected symptomatic abdominal aortic aneurysm
Severe stabbing chest/back/abdominal pain or acute pain with pulsatile mass

required_documentation: Urgent clinical notes documenting acute abdominal/back pain and clinical rationale for MRA (e.g. severe iodinated contrast allergy precluding CTA)
review_notes: Symptomatic AAA evaluation by MRA when CTA is contraindicated.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Suspected choledochal cyst after ultrasound has been done

criteria.description: Clinically suspected choledochal cyst or congenital biliary duct dilatation
Initial diagnostic workup with abdominal ultrasound completed

required_documentation: Abdominal ultrasound report documenting biliary tree visualization prior to MRCP
review_notes: Prerequisite ultrasound requirement prior to MRCP for congenital biliary cyst.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Suspected new onset acute pancreatitis and ALL of the following: ○ Epigastric or upper abdominal pain

criteria.description: Suspected new onset acute pancreatitis
Documented epigastric or upper abdominal pain

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing epigastric pain and reason for MRI/MRCP (e.g. occult choledocholithiasis, pregnancy, or iodinated contrast allergy)
review_notes: Pancreatitis evaluation by MRI/MRCP for ductal stones.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN PELVIS CTA / Other Vascular Abnormalities of the Abdomen and Pelvis
source_quote: Evaluation of known or suspected mesenteric ischemia/ischemic colitis

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion or known acute or chronic mesenteric ischemia or ischemic colitis

required_documentation: Urgent clinical notes detailing postprandial pain, bloody stools, or acute severe abdominal pain out of proportion to exam
review_notes: Urgent vascular mesenteric ischemia indication.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN PELVIS CTA / Other Vascular Abnormalities
source_quote: Suspected pelvic congestive syndrome (including May-Thurner and nutcracker syndromes) when ultrasound is indeterminant

criteria.description: Suspected pelvic congestion syndrome, May-Thurner, or nutcracker syndrome
Initial pelvic or vascular ultrasound was indeterminate

required_documentation: Pelvic or vascular duplex ultrasound report demonstrating indeterminate or incomplete evaluation of venous compression
review_notes: Diagnostic prerequisite ultrasound requirement for pelvic venous compression syndromes.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS / Peripheral Arterial Disease / Critical Limb Ischemia
source_quote: For acute critical limb ischemia with any ONE of the below clinical signs of peripheral vascular disease: ○ Ischemic rest pain ○ Tissue loss ○ Gangrene
clinical_service_or_procedure: CTA Abdominal Aorta with Lower Extremity Runoff

criteria.description: Suspected or known peripheral arterial disease with critical limb ischemia
At least one sign: ischemic rest pain, non-healing ischemic ulceration/tissue loss, or gangrene

required_documentation: Vascular surgery or podiatry exam documenting rest pain, tissue ulceration, or gangrene
review_notes: Urgent critical limb ischemia bypasses conservative medical trial.
